name: Deal Sourcer — Daily Pet & Wellness Digest
_setup_notes: 1. Import this file in n8n via Workflows → Import from File
2. Open the 'Send to Feishu' node and replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_WEBHOOK_TOKEN with your Feishu bot webhook token
3. Set 'active: true' (toggle the workflow on) to enable daily runs at 01:00 UTC (09:00 CST)
4. Click 'Execute Workflow' to do a manual test run first
